analogy.rationale: 5-alpha reductase inhibitors block conversion of testosterone to dihydrotestosterone, a peripheral steroidogenic step; prostate lines express SRD5A but the transcriptional consequence is modest and largely overlaps with androgen receptor pathway modulation. Other steroid hormone receptor classes share downstream androgen/steroid programs but act through different targets, so similarity is limited.
